5585945.name: Chabad at Ithaca College
5585945.note: Rabbi Raffy and Chana Filler in their own words, COLlive, 7 June 2024 ('Igniting Inspiration in Ithaca'): 'when we were offered a post of our own at Ithaca College'; 'We're still in the beginning stages, having moved out just under two years ago'; a student 'was delighted to find that Ithaca College had just welcomed its own shluchim'. Its chabad.org listing went up 11 Aug 2022.

117688.name: Roitman Chabad Center at Cornell University
117688.note: Cornell Law School's faculty page for Rabbi Eli Silberstein (adjunct professor): 'Rabbi Eli Silberstein is the founder and director of the Roitman Chabad Center which was established in 1984.' The IRS recognized The Roitman Chabad Center at Cornell Inc from 1986 (GuideStar), which agrees. Its chabad.org listing is in the first online directory (2004).
